sourcePolicy: Expectations are non-reconstructive historical regression metadata recovered from S.A.G.A.'s May 2026 real-book experiments. Copyrighted source text remains outside Git. Full-book expectations apply only to full-book runs; bounded opening-chapter expectations apply only to the explicitly recorded historical window configuration.

cases.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
notes: Historical opening regression: title/front-matter evidence must not mint Harry before in-story evidence.
Grunnings is an organization/group and Privet Drive is a location.
Standalone shared title Professor must not become a canonical character.

cases.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
notes: Recovered full-book failure: Harry/Harry Potter and Dumbledore/Professor Dumbledore fragmented into separate identities.
Recovered full-book failure: Hagrid, Snape, and Neville leaked into the old supporting bucket.

cases.title: A Court of Frost and Starlight
notes: High Lady may attach as a title but must not stand alone as canonical.
Night Court is not a character.

cases.title: A Court of Frost and Starlight
notes: Recovered full-book failure: real characters Cassian, Nesta, Rhys, Azriel, and Tamlin leaked into supporting entities.
Recovered false character admissions included Illyrian Mountains, High Fae, and Not Cassian.

cases.title: Caraval
notes: Recovered full-book failure: Julian remained supporting rather than canonical.
Recovered false character admission: Castillo Maldito.
Caraval Master Legend was historically flagged for title/name confusion but is not encoded as a hard merge until fresh evidence establishes the intended relation unambiguously.

cases.title: The Cruel Prince
notes: Recovered full-book failure: Cardan/Prince Cardan fragmented.
Recovered full-book failure: Taryn, Vivi, Valerian, and Nicasia leaked into supporting entities.

The old run produced 218 temporary candidates, indicating severe hesitation/noise; count-based thresholds are recorded historically but are not promoted to a hard v2 gate until the new result schema has an equivalent concept.
